summary: DDC Enterprise filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered direct offering of DDC SAVOR 13.5% Perpetual Cumulative Preferred Series A Shares at $20.00 per share, a 20% discount to the $25.00 stated and liquidation value. Investors committed to 1,200,000 shares for $24 million gross, with some subscriptions payable in non-cash digital assets converted to USD at closing. Dividends accrue at 13.5% of stated value, with contingent Bitcoin-linked bonus dividends up to $4.00 per share; shares are perpetual, non-convertible, callable at $26.25, and redeemable at par from November 2029. Closing requires a concurrent underwritten public offering of at least 200,000 shares. This is an ordinary capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution, preferred overhang, and Bitcoin-linked dividend triggers.
